new_family: option insurance premium; actual options, not an underlying indicator
short_put: highest listed strike at or below 90% of current index
long_put: highest listed strike at or below 80% of current index; same expiry
quantity: floor budget/maximum strike-width-plus-fee bound to minimum underlying amount increment; never increase size using expected profit
trading_fee: minimum of 3bps index notional and 12.5% executed premium, each leg
delivery_fee: minimum of 1.5bps settlement-index notional and 12.5% intrinsic; each ITM put; no netting discount or daily exemption
execution: sell into bid depth, buy from ask depth; reject inadequate books; no mark-price fill
exit: expiry; ITM physical future conversion followed immediately by USDC cash settlement
development_scenarios: all nonoverlapping ceil(DTE/8h) return blocks from old verified 2020Aug11–2026Sep30 panel, normalize to current index; not a historical options backtest
development_screen: positive credit, depth/cash/risk/freshness valid, positive mean and positive 5th percentile of 2000 seeded bootstrap means at both costs; no loss over conservative put-spread bound
